# axe-core (vendored)

`axe.min.js` is the unmodified minified build of
[axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) **4.10.3**, licensed under
the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`). It is vendored so that
`node tests/a11y.js` runs with no `npm install` — the same reason the repo
ships no `node_modules`.

To upgrade: download the new `axe.min.js` + `LICENSE` from the npm package
and update the version number here.
